visualLanguage: design_system/public/PUBLIC_UI.md. The KB-era index.html that used to sit in this directory was DELETED 2026-08-27: it was retired as a visual target on 2026-08-26 and kept only because ci:mockup-coverage required a parity.json beside any index.html, which is a gate keeping a dead file alive. The target is the patterns in PUBLIC_UI.md, built from components/site/v3. THIS FILE STILL BINDS: requiredComponents is what stops a page silently losing a section, and ci:mockup-parity reads it with or without a mockup.
competitiveTarget: Beat Zillow / Redfin / Windermere geo market pages. The answer in the first viewport (verdict, live figures, one source trace, one stamp, the monthly median series as Instrument.chart), sibling cities as Ledger doors, FAQ from the same buildMarketFaq array as FAQPage JSON-LD, and a single on-page ask.
note: Migrated off the dual KB/legacy register onto the v3 barrel 2026-08-13 (E-MARKET-REST). Both branches share V3Footer outside main. Rhythm: Breadcrumb, Instrument level 1 (chart on the Instrument, D9), Ledger (sibling cities), Quiet (FAQ), Sheet (inquiry), Quiet (edges), Footer. City chart is the newest-three-year monthly overlay from buildYearSeries, falling back to one chronological monthly line. Community chart is the 12-month median sale series when six or more complete months exist. Do not flatten those series to a figure. YTD / this-month / 12-month closed medians are Instrument figures, not a tabbed KB island. The verdict classifies the RAW months-of-supply value through marketVerdict(); formatMonthsOfSupply is display only. FAQPage JSON-LD moved from FAQBlock includeJsonLd onto MetadataBlock. Capture contract unchanged: GeoInquirySheet calls submitMarketPageInquiry with variant inquiry and fields name / email / message. KB-era deletions, city: KbHero, KbExploreTowns, KbArticles, FAQBlock, LeadCaptureBlock, KbSell, KbFooter, SmoothScrollProvider, MarketSources, KbMarketHud, KbMarketChart, KbTimeframeStats. Community deletions: PageBreadcrumb, HeroBlock, MarketSnapshot, MarketDetailStats, PriceBandTable stub, CityComparisonTable, ContentSection, FAQBlock, LeadCaptureBlock, RelatedAreas, CTABar, SiteFooter, DisplayHeading, buildNarrative, PriceChart. Closed-sales fields from the monthly cache row surface as Instrument figures on the community branch. marketHealthLabel is not printed.

dataLayer.getMarketPulse: lib/data/market/getMarketPulse.ts, market_pulse_live, geo_type from resolveGeo, 10 to 15 min freshness.
dataLayer.getPriceHistory: lib/data/market/getPriceHistory.ts, market_stats_cache monthly. limit=60 city, limit=24 community. In-progress current month dropped via zonedDateKey.
dataLayer.getMarketPulseCitySnapshots: lib/data/market/getMarketPulseSnapshot.ts, market_pulse_live city rows for COMPARISON_CITY_LABELS. ONE call per render.
dataLayer.getCityMarketDetailByTimeframe: lib/data/market/getCityMarketDetail.ts. City: YTD / month / 12-month medians as Instrument figures. Community: monthly row closed-sales figures on the Instrument.
dataLayer.getRecentBlogPosts: lib/data/blog/getRecentBlogPosts.ts, published newest first, limit=3. City scope only, closing Quiet edges.
dataLayer.buildYearSeries: lib/kb/year-series.ts. Groups completePriceMonths into up to 5 calendar-year lines, newest three of which plot as Instrument.chart. City scope only.
dataLayer.buildMarketFaq: lib/site/market-faq.ts. Both scopes. Fed pulse ?? {activeCount: null, medianListPrice: null, refreshedAt: null} so Dataset/FAQPage survive a missing row (G52).
dataLayer.submitMarketPageInquiry: app/housing-market/actions.ts, bound to GeoInquirySheet. Same action, same payload shape, same field names as the KB LeadCaptureBlock it replaces.
dataLayer.note: Every read is a DAL function from @/lib/data (G8). None is wrapped in a swallowing catch at the page. Route-local constants live in _v3/geo-constants.ts so the route file stays under the ci:file-size-budget floor. That file is NOT a geo registry.

sectionOrder: CityMarketView -- renders the level-1 geo Instrument (answer + chart), the sibling-cities Ledger, the market FAQ Quiet, and the outbound-edges Quiet; the CommunityMarketView arm does the same for community slugs

tasteReview.evaluator: separate claude-sonnet-5 evaluator agent, SITE-42 round 2 — a fresh agent given round one's five named findings to verify, the four shots, and the lane dev server URL, which it opened and scrolled end to end; scored three times in one call. Round one of the same instrument (a different agent instance, same model, same rubric, same shots) scored 61; round two scored the page harder after walking the whole DOM, and round two is the number recorded because it graded the shipped state. The breakdown below is the evaluator's own, and sums to its 53 pass rather than to the 54 median. The prior number for this class is the 2026-09-08 taste table mark of 53, from an instrument with no receipt, no recorded evaluator model and no shots on disk, so it is named here rather than as a priorMark.
tasteReview.beats: Redfin's Bend housing-market page: one median-price line with basic hover and no stated method. This page wins on trace — every section's disclosure names the source, the filter, the window and the row count, and the hero chart's hover returns all three plotted years for the same calendar month in one tooltip.

defects.finding: The dullest section on the page: four static percentage tiles with no bar length, no hover and no sentence saying what the share means, and it is the last content section before the footer, so the page closes on its most template-shaped display.
Six rows of city, count, months of supply and price with no visual encoding at all — the banned table-wearing-hairlines tell. Its only affordance is a navigation away, not more data in place.
Eight question and answer pairs render fully expanded with no disclosure and no figure beside any of them, and every answer is a number written as a sentence — the banned wall-of-text tell.

The opened trace still names the metric layer and its stamp, "Market Truth metric layer (mt-v1)". The evaluator reads that as internal shorthand; CLAUDE.md section 0 requires the methodology stamp to be cited on a served figure, so the stamp stays and the sentence around it was rewritten to plain English this round. Left as a named tension, not silently dropped.

defects.section: gap below the hero source line
defects.finding: About 255px of near-empty cream between the source row and the next section eyebrow, broken by one hairline. The section boxes are contiguous, so this is V3Instrument section spacing, not a structural hole.
Two Quiet sections — the FAQ prose block and the "what each report is" link list — carry the identical section shape, against the no-repeating-shape rule.
